entities.name: Dosan
entities.description: Oldest living kannushi on Kamigawa, perhaps the most revered, of the sacred order of Jukai Forest; teacher of Azusa.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: Sacred order to which Dosan belonged.

entities.name: Azusa
entities.description: The plane's most famous wanderer, taught by Dosan.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Dosan's peaceful teachings were mocked.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits of Kamigawa to whom Dosan prayed.

events.summary: Dosan met the wanderer Azusa in the forest and became her teacher.
events.quote: he met Azusa , the plane's most famous wanderer, and became her teacher

events.summary: During the Kami War Dosan prayed nightly to the kami, but their hate withered his body.
events.quote: Dosan prayed each night to the kami

events.summary: Dosan's teachings to live peacefully with the kami were denounced and eventually mocked.
events.quote: Dosan's teachings to live peacefully with the kami were denounced and eventually mocked

relations.note: He belonged to the sacred order of Jukai Forest.
relations.quote: He belonged to the sacred order of Jukai Forest
